commits.subject: C4 F3: broaden verified practice and trigger contexts
C4 F3: record CPU readiness and bank handoff contract
C4 F3: bind breadth restarts to verified budgeted evidence

blockers.summary: The shared breadth visitor now performs existing augmented-example/evidence/charge validation before practice selection or trigger teaching, including PLAN_FIX/variety roots. It requires the configured prelaunch registration and preserves child identity, parent, SUMO evidence, manifest hash and allocation/ledger provenance in frozen rows. Dispatch revalidates charges and evidence against the original source root. Native augmentation links without a verified manifest refuse admission.
blockers.regressions: Both B/R and current/PLAN_FIX sources, with weighting=True and breadth_cfg together: absent or empty ledger, wrong phase, wrong charge namespace, undercharging, allocation overrun, changed evidence and unregistered allocation; frozen plans preserve provenance and reject corrupted charges/evidence at wave construction.

blockers.summary: Restart eligibility is checked against the original sealed first-seed receipt snapshot hash, episode/world, arm and decision time before context identity is computed. Actual generator tensors must match verified RNG metadata. Native all8 seed metadata and own-seed receipt/tape/plan evidence bind CRN reconstruction; extra seeds use verify_perseed.extra_seed_salt. Frozen rows retain immutable first/own receipt, confirmation and example bindings, re-read and compared at dispatch. Legacy/imported contexts without an immutable snapshot binding are explicitly excluded and reported.
blockers.regressions: Native/imported LS/PLAN_FIX pre-selection and resumed snapshot substitution, world, episode, time and generator changes; augmented contexts cannot be certified by a new current hash; unbound legacy exclusions; native all8 first/own-seed receipt, salt, hash and tape mismatches; exact seed-3 restoration and receipt text; own-seed receipt plus confirmation replacement cannot alter frozen evidence; old reduced F3 lookups refuse dispatch.

api.bank_breadth.inputs: inputs(cfg) -> current and optional PLAN_FIX bank run_root/replay_sources entries; handoff schema remains coopmwm-plan-fix-banks-v1
api.bank_breadth.visit: visit(cfg, arm, consumer) -> all usable verified examples after augmented-child prelaunch validation; A is a no-op
api.bank_breadth.practice_pool: practice_pool(cfg, arm) -> distinct originally verified restart contexts with full frozen lookup/evidence, native CRN salt, family and retained child provenance
api.bank_breadth.verified_restart: verified_restart(root, arm, receipt, example, plan) -> (snapshot, immutable verification binding)
api.bank_breadth.load_verified_restart: load_verified_restart(arm, lookup) -> snapshot after original source and frozen evidence revalidation
api.practice_weighting.augmented_examples: Added keyword-only deduplicate=True; breadth uses False to retain every validated child's provenance before restart-context deduplication; default callers retain existing behavior
api.practice_starts.plan_for_update: Existing breadth_cfg and weighting parameters retained; both enabled together enforce registered augmentation admission before a new plan is frozen
api.practice_starts.load_snapshot: Breadth lookups require binding_version=1, re-read original/own-seed evidence, preserve native CRN and recheck child evidence/charges at the source root before wave dispatch
api.launch_production.bank_move_supervision: Existing broad observable-context/family-normalized CE path now shares augmented-child admission checks

tests.skip_reason: Existing test_launch_integration_cpu.py:526 requires Windows file-symlink privilege. No remote qualification was run in this fix round.
tests.fixtures: Native on-disk sealed bank receipts, confirmations, per-seed admission, branch tape hashes, LS reconstruction and restart loading. Only observable-feature attachment is mocked for the new bank regressions; no physics execution or production data is used.
retained_coverage: Default-off/shared-base byte parity and A guidance isolation
Full-pool rotation, repeat caps and matched B/R family distribution
Actual trigger CE learning with frozen base weights and gradients
Production backend wiring, practice waves and realized practice reporting

integration_requirements: Apply at a new update boundary. Existing frozen plans are not overwritten; pre-fix F3 lookups lacking original verification bindings refuse dispatch.
Stage PLAN_FIX/S-VARIETY banks with original immutable snapshot and per-seed evidence, observable tapes, and source-reader dependencies.
Augmented children require a verified native manifest plus the same augmentation_prelaunch registration as the runtime, with complete branch charges within the registered <=200000 sim-s allocation.
B/R verified family support must match; no unverified context is substituted to fill a family quota.
open_issues: Real production/PLAN_FIX/S-VARIETY artifacts and current B/R family support were not inspected; validation in this CPU-only round used native-format fixture banks.
Legacy native-plan projection remains approximate; only a separately re-verified library plan certifies the projected action's realized outcome.
